notes: Read SKILL.md (340 lines) in full; it is the only file in source. Guidance and C# samples for the preview Azure.ResourceManager.WeightsAndBiases SDK: create, get, list, update, delete W&B instances via Azure Marketplace and configure Entra ID SSO, plus a short W&B Python SDK usage snippet.

Tells the agent to run `dotnet add package ... --prerelease` (SKILL.md:19-20) and mentions `pip install wandb` (SKILL.md:310); uses the developer's real Azure credentials to create/update/delete Marketplace-backed ARM resources (SKILL.md:118-119, 184, 204, 214). The agent itself does not handle real secrets: credential and service calls live in sample code for the user's application. Medium for package installs (one unpinned prerelease) and state-changing, billable cloud operations; acceptable because packages are official and actions target the user's own subscription for the requested task.

The sample provisions a pay-as-you-go Marketplace plan (SKILL.md:88-96) that can incur charges, and delete is ungated in the sample; agents should confirm before running these against real subscriptions. The SDK is preview (v1.0.0-beta.1), so APIs may change. The wandb.login snippet relies on the user's own W&B API key.
